# pangolin_ai_provider (Resource)

Manages an AI provider (an upstream AI gateway backend) in Pangolin. Attach an existing provider to an inference-mode pangolin_resource via that resource's ai_providers attribute. Import using the numeric provider ID, e.g. `terraform import pangolin_ai_provider.example 5`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pangolin_ai_provider" "example" {
  org_id  = pangolin_organization.example.org_id
  name    = "OpenAI"
  type    = "openai"
  api_key = var.openai_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the provider.
- `org_id` (String) Organization ID this provider belongs to.
- `type` (String) One of openai, anthropic, googleGemini, vertexAi, bedrock, microsoftFoundry, openRouter, vercelAiGateway, custom.

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key used to authenticate to the upstream provider. Returned back from the API in plaintext on every read, so Terraform can keep state in sync; still marked sensitive to keep it out of plan/apply output.
- `auth_type` (String) How the API key is sent upstream: bearer, x-api-key, x-goog-api-key, hec, cf-aig-authorization, none, or passthrough. Defaults based on type.
- `capabilities` (List of String) API surfaces this provider exposes, e.g. openai_chat, anthropic_messages. Required (at least one) for type = custom; defaulted for other types.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this provider is enabled.
- `headers` (Attributes List) Extra headers sent with every request to the upstream provider. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--headers))
- `routing_mode` (String) url (default; proxies to upstream_url) or target (routes through a pangolin_target, custom type only).
- `skip_tls_verification` (Boolean) Whether to skip TLS certificate verification when connecting to the upstream provider.
- `upstream_url` (String) Upstream API base URL. Required for most provider types; not used for type = custom with routing_mode = target.

### Read-Only

- `nice_id` (String) Human-readable ID, unique per org.
- `provider_id` (Number) Server-generated provider ID.
